name: nuxtjs-changelog
description: A zero-config Nuxt module to automate your release notes page with a single JSON file.
author: Lskrzypc

scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && nuxt dev playground
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run prepack
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxt prepare playground
scripts.release: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run prepack && changelogen --release && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.preversion: git checkout dev && git pull && npm run check && git checkout main && git pull && git merge dev
scripts.postversion: git push --tags && git push && git checkout dev && git rebase main && git push
